## .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md

```markdown
---

## Prompt Information
**Prompt Name/Path**: (e.g., `development/php/phpstan-error-resolution.md`)

## Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened.

## Reproduction Steps
1. Copy the prompt...
2. Replace placeholders with...
3. Submit to [AI tool]...
4. See error...

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

## Environment
- **AI Tool**: (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Bard)
- **AI Model**: (e.g., GPT-4, Claude 3.7 Sonnet)
- **Browser/Platform**: (if relevant)

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here.

## Proposed Fix (optional)
If you have an idea how to fix the issue, please describe it here.
